subject: CS240
filterSummary: Selected 10 videos covering 5 key graph algorithm topics in English and Arabic. The English selections feature highly-rated, visually-driven explanations from channels like Abdul Bari, Jenny's Lectures, and WilliamFiset. The Arabic selections draw from popular educational series by Adel Nasim and Ahmed Hashim, ensuring comprehensive and well-regarded content for each topic. All selections passed strict quality, relevance, and metadata gates.
